title: Run contract
description: Authorisation of one autonomous run of the Asistente (feature 028, FR-001). Validated in product code by backend/app/assistant/auto.py (RunContract); the model never edits it.

goal.description: The user's request, verbatim, shown in the contract line of the transcript.

sources.description: Empty means no restriction on source tools. A listed source name restricts list_sources/describe_source/profile_source/check_query to those names; a listed table restricts the table argument.

stages.description: hasta el borrador = [draft]; hasta vista previa = [draft, preview]; hasta aplicar = [draft, preview, apply].

modify_existing.description: When false the agent creates new integration/report ids and never alters an existing artifact (US4/AC2).

auto_rollback.description: Restore the previous workspace version if the first scheduled run after apply fails (FR-008).

visible_to.description: Empty means no dashboard_access grants: no user-role account sees the applied dashboard. 'user' grants access to the active user-role accounts; 'admin' changes nothing because administrators already see every non-hidden dashboard.

profile_id.description: Saved profile the form was prefilled from (US5). Never an authorisation by itself.
